izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.name: WG Tunnel
izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.summary: A WireGuard & AmneziaWG VPN client with auto-tunneling, lockdown & proxying.
izzyondroid:com.zaneschepke.wireguardaut.description:
WG Tunnel is a WireGuard VPN client that strikes the balance between simplicity and robustness, making it the ideal client for casual and power users alike. Whether you simply want to automate when you're connected to your VPN or you're a power user with advanced privacy use cases, WG Tunnel has you covered.
 Features:
 Auto-Tunneling: Automatically activate tunnels based on your device's active network details.
 Deferred Endpoint Bootstrapping: Safely resolves endpoints and updates peers after the tunnel is up for better reliability and leak protection on startup.
 Handshake Monitoring: Real-time handshake monitoring for instant tunnel health feedback.
 AmneziaWG Support: Full support for AmneziaWG 2.0 through 3.1, providing robust censorship protection.
 Split Tunneling: Flexible support for routing specific apps or traffic through the VPN.
 Split & Encrypted DNS: Resolve DNS through the tunnel using plain DNS, DoT, or DoH, and optionally split by domain suffix (tunnel or system).
 Local Proxy Mode: Expose WireGuard tunnels over a local SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy to browsers or firewall apps (like AdGuard).
 Lockdown Mode: Advanced in-app kill switch that blocks all traffic while the tunnel is down.
 Quick Controls: Quick Settings tile and home screen shortcuts for easy toggling.
 Remote Control Support: Intent-based automation for controlling tunnels and auto-tunneling from automation apps (like Tasker).
 Dynamic DNS Handling: Automatically detect and update endpoints on server IP changes without requiring a restart.
 IPv6 Endpoints: Automatically upgrade to IPv6 endpoints or fall back to IPv4 based on network conditions without requiring a restart.
 Android TV Support: Full support for nearly all features on Android TV.

fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.name: Adiresy
fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.summary: Find, share and navigate to Madagascar's community address codes
fdroid:org.github.nynosy.adiresy_mobile.description:
Adiresy is a native Android client for Adiresy, an unofficial addressing service for Madagascar.
Madagascar has no formal street-addressing system in most areas. Every building can still get a short, permanent code anchored to GPS coordinates (for example 101-6EAR-50418). This app lets people find, share, and navigate to those codes — working on low-end phones, and, progressively, fully offline.
Codes have no legal value. Adiresy is an unofficial, community-driven addressing layer, not a government service.
Features:
* Find the Adiresy code for a building and share it as a link or QR code.
* Resolve a shared code and see the building on a map.
* Search by code, place name, or administrative area (region, district, commune, fokontany).
* Download offline map data for all of Madagascar, at a regional-overview or city-level detail.
* Save favourite locations for quick access later.
* Offline routing and turn-by-turn navigation are planned for future releases.
Design goals:
* Offline-first — core tasks work with the radio off, once map data is downloaded.
* Built and tuned for budget hardware — 1-2 GB Android Go devices.
* Cheap on data and battery — no background location or wake-locks outside active navigation; downloads are Wi-Fi-only by default, resumable, and interruption-safe.
* Malagasy, French, and English are all first-class UI languages.
* Privacy-respecting — no account, no analytics by default. GPS coordinates are sent to the Adiresy API only for explicit, user-initiated lookups, never tracked, batched, or persisted server-side by the app.

firefox-addons:3037494.description:
Insty adds privacy controls and follower-checking tools to Instagram. It can prevent selected direct messages from being marked as read, prevent stories from

Open the extension popup to enable or disable each privacy control. The follower check runs only after you click “Check subscriptions” while Instagram is open.
Insty processes Instagram information locally in Firefox. It does not send account information, browsing activity, follower lists, settings, or analytics to the
 developer or any developer-controlled server.
Features:

 Find accounts that do not follow you back
 Store settings and results locally

Insty is an independent extension and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Instagram or Meta.

firefox-addons:3066769.name: ScriptGuard — Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:3066769.summary: Heuristic learning lets ScriptGuard detect and block suspicious scripts based on behavior, not just lists giving you adaptive, real‑time protection while you browse.
firefox-addons:3066769.description:
ScriptGuard is an open‑source privacy and security extension designed to stop dangerous scripts before they execute. It blocks ads, trackers, fingerprinting attempts, dynamic script injections, and third‑party surveillance at the network layer. ScriptGuard includes WebRTC and Blob leak protection, fingerprint request deletion, heuristic tracking detection, and a multi‑mode privacy system (OFF, BASIC, PRO, MAXIMUM).
No telemetry, no data collection, no background analytics all processing happens locally in your browser.
Users can whitelist sites, export/import rules, and generate manual privacy reports. ScriptGuard is built for transparency, security, and full user control.

Simple one-click interface for fast results.

Press the "Analyze Privacy Score" button.
The extension will evaluate the current webpage and display the privacy score in a popup.

firefox-addons:961619.name: Download by Internet Download Manager
firefox-addons:961619.summary: Optionally use Internet Download Manager instead of the built-in download manager to get large files
firefox-addons:961619.description:
This extension provides a reliable integration to "Internet Download Manager" from your browser. The extension offers two modes of operation:
1. Context menu items over a link, audio, video and image element
2. Interrupt the built-in download manager and grab the downloadable job to send to the external download manager.
This extension is very lightweight on resource usage. Basically, it does not use anything when the network observer is disabled. 
A user can define the following conditions to call the external download manager automatically when the extension is enabled from the toolbar area:
1. Only call when file-size is larger than a defined value
2. Only call when the file-type is not in the defined list of mime-types
3. Only call when the download server supports multi-threading
Note: for this extension to operate you will need to install a native-client. For this project, I am using an open-source NodeJS based native-client. You will be notified on the first usage about the installation guide. This native-client is only available on Windows, Linux and Mac OS. 
--- Legal
"Internet Download Manager" is a trademark of Tonec Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. This extension is an independent project and has no relationship to "Internet Download Manager" team or Tonec Inc. It is only built in a hope to be a lightweight and useful integrator.

firefox-addons:2917403.name: Checkbox Tools

 🔚 End-Range Control: Enable or disable the last N checkboxes, providing flexible batch operations from the end of the list.
 🎯 Streamlined Workflow: Designed to accelerate tasks involving forms, surveys, testing, or any scenario requiring bulk checkbox manipulation.
 🛠️ Clean and Intuitive Interface: Minimalistic design ensures ease of use without sacrificing functionality.
 ⚡ Smooth Animations and Responsive UI: Visual feedback enhances user experience without distraction.
Use Cases
Checkbox Tools is ideal for professionals and power users including:
 Quality assurance engineers performing web form testing.
 Data entry personnel working with large-scale form inputs.
 Developers and testers automating repetitive UI tasks.
 Any user seeking to improve efficiency by batch toggling checkbox inputs.
Why Choose Checkbox Tools?
Managing numerous checkbox inputs manually can be time-consuming and error-prone. Checkbox Controller eliminates these inefficiencies by providing precise, batch control, thereby reducing user effort and enhancing productivity.
Checkbox Tools is a reliable and efficient solution for advanced checkbox management in modern web environments. Download now to streamline your workflow and regain control over checkbox selections.

apple-macos:6451055362.description:
FeedDeck is an open source RSS and social media feed reader, inspired by TweetDeck. FeedDeck allows you to follow your favorite feeds in one place on all platforms. FeedDeck is written in Flutter and uses Supabase and Deno as it's backend.
- Available for mobile and desktop: FeedDeck provides the same experience for mobile and desktop with nearly 100% code sharing.
- RSS and Social Media Feeds: Follow your favorite RSS and social media feeds.
- News: Get the latest news from your favorite RSS feeds and Google News.
- Social Media: Follow your friends and favorite topics on Medium, Reddit and Tumblr.
- GitHub: Get your GitHub notifications and follow your repository activities.
- Podcasts: Follow and listen to your favorite podcasts, via the built-in podcast player.
- YouTube: Follow and view your favorite YouTube channels.
Terms & Conditions: https://feeddeck.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://feeddeck.app/privacy-policy

apple-itunes:1078986931.description:
Food delivery service from grocery stores, cafes and restaurants
You can order both burgers and steaks, as well as products from grocery stores. Free delivery for your first order!
ALL NEARBY GROCERIES AND RESTAURANTS IN ONE APP
Get your groceries delivered from both popular stores and local markets. And for those who don't want to cook, you can find your favorite dishes from cafes and restaurants. In Yandex Eats, you can order a cooked pizza or ingredients for it.
ORDER FAST DELIVERY TO YOUR ADDRESS
Enter the delivery address — we will find the nearest store or restaurant to you and deliver the order as quickly as possible. On average food is delivered in 32 minutes after placing an order — even faster than you would get ready to go shopping.
TRACK YOUR ORDER 
In the app, you can find out the status of the order and the location of the courier.
USE FILTERS TO FIND EVERYTHING YOU NEED
With filters you can find a specific cuisine or dish with one click. “Burgers”, “Sushi”, “Pizza” — Yandex Eats has sets for every occasion.
DISCOUNTS AND SPECIAL OFFERS EVERY DAY 
In the app, you can place an order profitably: for example, get free delivery or a dish as a gift. In the section “Promotions” we collect the best offers from shops and restaurants every day.
Yandex Eats is an information service. Delivery zones, delivery times, and restaurant offers are limited. To learn more, go to eda.yandex. Fast delivery: the average order delivery time is 32 minutes according to data from January 18 to January 25, 2022.

Get real-time access to daily activity updates, billing, enrollment, compliance, messaging, and more. Directors save hours of admin work per week. Families get a window into their child’s day. Teachers spend less time on paperwork and more time teaching.
FAMILY EXPERIENCE
- Engage families with a single platform that makes communication effortless and meaningful.
- Real-time activity feed (meals, naps, diapering, potty, sunscreen)
- Daily reports with photos, videos, and notes
- Personalized calendars and newsletters
- Digital paperwork and e-signatures
- In-app messaging, announcements, and RSVPs
- Mobile check-in/out with ETA sharing
- Tuition billing and payment in one place

- Digital attendance & live ratio tracking
- Staff clock-in/out & timecards
- Pay staff and file payroll taxes
- CACFP and subsidy tracking
- Paperwork automation and custom packets
- Late pickup fee automation
- Allergy alerts and food program tracking
- Licensing-ready reports
LEARNING & OBSERVATION
- Support child development and curriculum planning with tools that work for teachers and families.
- Lesson plan builder and internal curriculum bank
- State standard alignment or custom domains
- Developmental milestone tracking
- Child development reports
- Activity observations with media
- Easy family sharing
ENGAGEMENT & COMMUNICATION
- Keep families informed and staff aligned—with minimal lift.
- Messaging, daily student feed, branded email newsletters, and SMS announcements
- Staff and family communication
- Scheduled posts and approval settings
- Media gallery and downloadable content
- Engagement dashboard with classroom and student-level insights
REPORTING & COMPLIANCE
- Replace clunky systems with one fast, customizable reporting suite.
- Customizable, real-time reports across billing, attendance, staff time, food, and more
- Exportable and printable reports for licensing and audits
- Ratio alerts and missing signature flags
Whether you’re a parent checking in from your phone or a director running a multi-site operation, Playground brings clarity, connection, and control to every part of your day.
Download Playground today and experience the difference.

apple-itunes:1598433714.name: Apple Music Classical
apple-itunes:1598433714.description:
Get the app designed specifically for classical music. Available to Apple Music subscribers at no additional cost. Instantly find any recording in the world’s largest classical music catalog with search built for the genre. Enjoy the highest audio quality available (up to 24-bit/192 kHz Hi-Res Lossless) and hear classical favorites like never before in Spatial Audio—all with zero ads.
Apple Music Classical also makes it easy for beginners to get to know the classical genre thanks to time-synced listening guides for many popular works, hundreds of Essentials playlists, insightful composer biographies, and personalized recommendations based on recently-played composers, instruments, and periods.
The Ultimate Classical Experience
• Get unlimited access to the world’s largest classical music catalog (over 5 million tracks) with everything from new releases to celebrated masterpieces, plus thousands of exclusive albums.
• Search by composer, work, conductor, or even catalog number, and find specific recordings instantly.
• Listen in the highest audio quality (up to 24 bit/192 kHz Hi-Res Lossless) and enjoy thousands of recordings in immersive Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos.
• Appreciate famous works more deeply with listening guides—moment-by-moment expert notes from the Apple Music Classical editors.
• Know exactly who and what you’re listening to thanks to complete, accurate metadata.
• Enjoy nonstop music with brand new stations curated by our editors and themed by instrument, composer, period, or genre.
• Learn about each classical period with The Story of Classical audio guides.
• Discover new favorites on the Home tab with personalized recommendations based on your listening.
• Dig deeper as you listen, with insightful album notes, descriptions of key works, and thousands of composer biographies.
• Browse booklets for thousands of albums including in-depth liner notes, translations, and more.
• Listen with CarPlay for music on the move.
• Ask Siri to play a composer, work or instrument.
• Listen using AirPlay on compatible wireless devices.
Requirements
• Requires an Apple Music subscription (Individual, Student, Family, or Apple One).
• Availability and features vary by country and region, plan, or device. The list of countries where Apple Music Classical is available can be found at https://support.apple.com/HT204411.
• Apple Music Classical is available for all iPhones and iPads running iOS or iPadOS 18.0 or later.
• To listen to music on Apple Music Classical, you must have an internet connection.
